experiments.name: PMax purchase-only optimization

change_guard.reason: Recommendation and instrumentation changes can alter conversion environment during PMax purchase-only evaluation.
change_guard.exception_policy: No implied exception: explicit scoped approval, before snapshot and post-change evaluation boundary are required.

experiments.notes: Mixed day 2026-11-11 is excluded from clean-day comparisons. All four historical Shopify orders were confirmed internal tests.

observed_interventions.source: executing_agent_report_for_theme_and_metafield; Shopify API direct readback for published despachos page
observed_interventions.effects: Affects buyer-visible shipping/discount messaging; order/shipping rules unchanged; cannot attribute all post-change conversion variation solely to Purchase-only bidding.

observed_interventions.source: Shopify Admin discount and shipping policy independently read back; checkout and theme QA reported by executing agent
observed_interventions.effects: Automatic free standard shipping now combines with 30% order discount without subtotal minimum. This changes final shopper economics during PMax observation; 2026-11-12 is mixed and does NOT support single-variable full-day attribution.

observed_interventions.source: Executing agent metafield write with CAS; Shopify Admin API direct readback of custom.promo_campaigns and of both active automatic discounts
observed_interventions.effects: Restores buyer-visible 30% discount price display that was suppressed by a gap in promo campaign scheduling. Actual automatic discount rules, PMax bid strategy and PMax budget were NOT modified. This is a buyer-visible promo display change, not a checkout rule change, and it further mixes the 2026-11-12 observation window.

browser_qa_followup.result: Both P0 PDPs confirmed in a real mobile browser with QA isolation: compact MB shows 21,657 CLP against habitual 30,938 CLP; lipstick LV shows 31,618 CLP against habitual 45,169 CLP. 30% automatic discount plus no-minimum free standard shipping copy present on both. No '--:--:--' countdown placeholder rendered. MSX_RECS_CONFIG reported internal=true with qa_run_id=qa-t18-20261112, so no PostHog exposure or click pollution.
browser_qa_followup.open_items: On both PDPs the add-to-cart button sits below the first mobile viewport (top ~1211 CSS px at 390x844) and no msx-sticky-buy element renders on the product page. Not a promo-display defect; recorded for follow-up only.

experiments.first_clean_business_day_qualification: Potential first whole day after T13; valid only if no new material interventions; not a pure single-variable comparison with pre-T13.
